## Summary

Founding senior engineer with a passion for software development who helped guide an AI agent platform from early-stage to paying customers, shipping significant product features end-to-end. Self-directed and able to drive work to completion, while also thriving in close collaboration on a team.

## Education

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Information Systems from Grove City College - Graduated in 2018.

## Technical skills

- Languages: Python, SQLite, Java, PHP, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, MySQL, HTML, CSS, and SCSS. Familiar with C#, Swift, SwiftUI, C++, C, ASP.NET, SQL Server, DirectX, and assembly.
- Applications and technologies: Codex, Claude Code, LLM orchestration, API development, Docker, Node.js, Kubernetes, Firebase, Azure, Git, GitHub, GitLab, GCP, IntelliJ, SAML, OAuth, and Keycloak.

## Experience

### Gobii - Senior Software Engineer (Founding Engineer), August 2025 to Present

- Developed and shipped a production AI agent platform that utilized LLM orchestration, tool calling, MCP, and browser automation to streamline complex processes, taking the platform from early-stage to production with paying customers in 12 months.
- Operated the full stack: Kubernetes on GCP, Postgres/Neon, SQLite for agent memory, Stripe billing, and OpenTelemetry observability.
- Second hire and founding engineer working across every layer of the stack while also running customer support, incidents, and reliability.
- Shipped features at high velocity, using AI-assisted development paired with rigorous human review to maintain high quality.
- Maintained an eval suite to keep agent outputs consistent across non-deterministic workflows.

### Yakabod, Inc. (now Everfox, Inc.) - Senior Software Engineer, May 2018 to August 2025

- Operated as a technical lead on multiple projects. Designed the system architecture, delegated tasks to other developers, wrote documentation, and executed on plans ahead of schedule.
- Implemented an enterprise single sign-on feature, adding SAML and OIDC support via Keycloak to centralize and secure authentication across the platform.
- Migrated legacy JavaScript and React stack to TypeScript, including a new build process for development and production applications.
- Developed a large-scale React with TypeScript dashboard framework, implementing an extensible architecture for reusable component properties and customizable layout.
- Led adoption for AI-assisted tooling across the development team.
